description: ONE broadcast to many people on ONE channel, from the brand's own connected account: sms, whatsapp, imessage, instagram, facebook (Messenger), telegram, line, x, bluesky or slack. A draft holds the message (text with {{first_name}}-style merge fields; WhatsApp: an approved template, plus text for people inside 24 hours; SMS / iMessage: media links) and an audience (segment: tags (all), anyTags, excludeTags, isSubscribed, customFields {slug: value} compared as each field's type, source). actions: list (status, channel) · get · create { name, channel, message {text, mediaUrls}, template {name, language, variables}, segment, from (the sending number / line / WhatsApp phone number id), contacts | phones | useSegment } · update (draft only) · add_recipients { contacts (ids, emails, phones, "platform:id"), phones (phone channels; each becomes a contact), useSegment:true } · remove_recipients { contacts | all } · recipients { status pending|sent|delivered|read|failed|skipped } · schedule { scheduledAt } · send · cancel (a scheduled one goes back to a draft; a sending one stops before the next person) · delete · refresh (reads delivery back on SMS and iMessage). Everyone is addressed when added: a person the channel cannot reach (opted out, no Telegram chat with the bot, no LINE friendship, no X user id, Instagram / Messenger outside 24 hours) is listed as skipped with the reason. send and schedule message real people: without confirm:true AND confirmCount equal to the number it reaches, NOTHING is sent and you get the sentence naming the count, channel, sender, message and cost: show it to the user first. Sent one at a time; nobody is sent the same broadcast twice, even on a resume. Free in Hermoso except X (X bills each DM, so credits per person, stated before sending); each platform bills its own fees.

confirm.description: REQUIRED true to send, schedule or delete

confirmCount.description: send / schedule: the number of people it reaches, as the preview said

from.description: SMS: the brand's number; iMessage: its line; WhatsApp: the phone number id
